See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''legionaries''' are members of [[Caesar's Legion]] who appear {{in|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ===[[The Profligate]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ===[[The Other Player]]=== Two legionaries walk along the hallway in the [[Las Vegas management Vault]] as [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] intends to knock them out. However, they are friendly due to the implanted [[Brain-computer interface chip|brain chip]]. ===[[The Strip]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ==Appearances== These legionaries appear only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|10=202|11=203|14=206|16=208}} ==Behind the scenes== Two legionaries, portrayed by [[Nate Holston]] and [[Justin Shilton]], are credited for speaking roles in "[[The Other Player]]." In the same episode and beyond, there is a [[massive legionary]] portrayed by stunt actor [[Casey Hendershot]].
